## Review checklist

- [ ] Focused diff; existing routes, watch-progress IDs and unrelated work preserved.
- [ ] Relevant tests/build passed or failures are explained above.
- [ ] No `.env`, tokens, Formspree account secrets, private reports or personal data in code/logs/screenshots.
- [ ] Asset provenance, license and attribution reviewed; no unlicensed copyrighted uploads.
- [ ] Cast claims retain their correct evidence tier; portraits do not prove casting (or N/A).
- [ ] Documentation is accurate; licensing, privacy or security decisions needing owner review are called out.
